# Practice Design Checklist

Use this when reviewing or generating a practice exercise.

## Objectives
- [ ] 2–4 specific, observable learning objectives are defined.
- [ ] Each objective begins with a verb: "Identify", "Implement", "Explain", "Trace", "Debug".
- [ ] Objectives are achievable in the allotted time (1–2 class sessions).

## Steps
- [ ] Steps are sequential — each one builds on the previous.
- [ ] No single step is longer than 20 minutes at beginner pace.
- [ ] Conceptual steps (read, understand) alternate with hands-on steps (write, run, fix).
- [ ] Each step has a clear expected output ("you should see X in the terminal").

## Checkpoints
- [ ] At least 2 checkpoints in a practice of >4 steps.
- [ ] Each checkpoint is a question or mini-task, not just "does it run?".
- [ ] Checkpoints are self-assessable (student can verify without instructor).

## Deliverables
- [ ] Deliverables are specific and verifiable (not "understand the model").
- [ ] File names or output formats are specified.
- [ ] Minimum deliverable is defined separately from optional extensions.

## Difficulty Calibration
- [ ] Prerequisites are stated explicitly.
- [ ] Beginner path completes in time without extensions.
- [ ] At least 2 extension tasks available for faster students.
